vibe: Calm, grounded, minimalist, and deeply professional. Reduces cognitive overload using strategic minimalism, bold clean typography, and airy layouts.

typography.instructions: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) on all headings above 24px.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background (bg-card), sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-sm or max rounded-md), crisp 1px border (border-border), absolutely NO drop shadows. Elevate purely through borders and negative space.
surfaces_and_borders.hover_states: Slight background tint change (hover:bg-muted) rather than adding shadows.
surfaces_and_borders.radius: 4px (rounded-sm) for a structured, architectural feel. Avoid pill-shaped buttons unless it's a specific filter chip.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical dense SaaS apps.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Control Room Grid with breathing room. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 or md:grid-cols-12 for complex layouts. Gap-6 or gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Containers with borders must have internal padding of at least p-6 or p-8.
spacing_and_layout.table_layout: Minimal table-focused layout. Tables should stretch full width without being enclosed in a heavily padded card. The table header should have a subtle background (bg-muted/50), but rows should just have a simple border-b border-border.

components.tables: Use Shadcn Table but customize it: remove outer borders, use border-y only for rows. Generous padding in cells (py-4 px-4). text-sm for data, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider for headers. Use organic color coding for statuses (e.g. success_light bg with success_dark text for 'Completed').
components.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Chart). Keep tooltips minimal. Colors: use primary (#2B593F) and a lighter sage (#A3E6B4) for data lines/bars. No grid lines except subtle horizontal guides.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Override radius to rounded-sm. Primary button: bg-[#2B593F] hover:bg-[#1C2922] text-white. Outline button: border-border text-foreground hover:bg-muted.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Ensure 1px solid border (border-input), focus state must have a crisp ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-1).
components.navigation: Top or side navigation should use a solid background (bg-card or bg-background) with a bottom or right 1px border. No glassmorphism here, keep it solid and grounded.

motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.interactions: All interactive elements must have a distinct hover state (e.g. background color shift) and focus-visible state for accessibility.

image_urls.description: Textured light green fabric background. Can be used in low opacity (10-20%) behind key summary stat cards or the welcome banner to add physical texture.
Professional woman in a gray suit. Use for the logged-in user profile picture.

media.icons: lucide-react. Keep stroke-width to 1.5 for a sophisticated, lighter look.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, table rows, tab triggers) must have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='order-approve-button', data-testid='date-range-filter').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA or WCAG AA standards. Muted text must still be clearly legible.

specific_functionalities.order_management: Use simple, immediate actions. Approve/Reject should be clear icon-buttons or small text buttons inside the table row. Include confirmation dialogs (Shadcn Dialog) for destructive actions.
specific_functionalities.dashboard_stats: Display Total Orders, Earnings, Pending Count in an airy 3-column or 4-column bento grid at the top. Use large typography for numbers (text-4xl font-light tracking-tight).
specific_functionalities.product_price_management: Can be a separate tab or a drawer (Shadcn Sheet) sliding in from the right to quickly adjust pricing without leaving the context.
specific_functionalities.export_options: A secondary button next to date filters: 'Export CSV', showing a quick download toast (Sonner) on completion.
